knowledge:
- key_parameters: pattern=A regular expression defining the barcode backbone, where brackets () capture the barcode or UMI sequence ;; pattern_type=A named integer vector (e.g., c("UMI" = 1, "barcode" = 2)) mapping the capture groups in the pattern to their respective types ;; cell_barcode_tag=The cell barcode field tag in the SAM file (default is "CR" in Cell Ranger output) ;; umi_tag=The UMI field tag in the SAM file (default is "UR" in Cell Ranger output) ;; depth=The minimum read or UMI count threshold required for a barcode to pass filtering ;; isUpdate=Logical; if TRUE, filters the cleanBc slot (e.g., after UMI curing), otherwise filters the messyBc slot ;; doFish=Logical; if TRUE, searches for low-depth identical barcodes to rescue their UMI counts ;; isUniqueUMI=Logical; if TRUE, treats UMIs as absolutely unique and keeps only the most abundant barcode per UMI ;; dist_thresh=An integer specifying the edit distance threshold for merging similar barcode sequences ;; dist_method=The distance algorithm for evaluating barcode similarity ("hamm" for Hamming or "leven" for Levenshtein)
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation, though standard external command-line tools like samtools are recommended for preprocessing BAM files to SAM format.
- when_to_use: Appropriate for genetic lineage tracing, clonal tracking, CRISPR gRNA screening, immune repertoire sequencing, and metagenome amplicon data analysis where barcodes and UMIs are embedded in sequencing reads.
- pitfalls: In the messyBc slot, barcode_seq values may not be unique because different full read sequences can contain the same barcode sequence due to UMI variations or mutations in constant regions ;; Using bc_cure_depth with isUpdate = FALSE on UMI data will discard UMI information and merge identical barcodes across different UMI-barcode tags before filtering ;; Ensure the row names of the metadata data frame are strictly consistent with the sample names.

workflows.name: fastq_lineage_barcoding
workflows.intent: Perform quality control, filter, extract, cure, and quantify lineage barcodes and UMIs from raw FASTQ files.
input: fq_files (vector of paths to fastq.gz files)
metadata (data.frame containing sample metadata with row names matching sample names)
workflows.stages: 1. Evaluate sequence quality using bc_seq_qc and visualize with bc_plot_seqQc ;; 2. Filter low-quality reads using bc_seq_filter ;; 3. Extract barcodes and UMIs using bc_extract ;; 4. Subset samples using bc_subset (optional) ;; 5. Filter UMI-barcode tags using bc_cure_umi ;; 6. Filter by sequence/UMI depth using bc_cure_depth ;; 7. Cluster and merge similar barcodes using bc_cure_cluster ;; 8. Visualize barcode distributions using bc_plot_single, bc_plot_mutual, or bc_plot_pair ;; 9. Export quantified barcodes using bc_2df, bc_2dt, or bc_2matrix
workflows.code:
example_data <- system.file("extdata", "mef_test_data", package = "CellBarcode")
fq_files <- dir(example_data, "fastq.gz", full=TRUE)

# prepare metadata for the samples
metadata <- stringr::str_split_fixed(basename(fq_files), "_", 10)[, c(4, 6)]
metadata <- as.data.frame(metadata)
sample_name <- apply(metadata, 1, paste, collapse = "_")
colnames(metadata) = c("cell_number", "replication")
# metadata should has the row names consistent to the sample names
rownames(metadata) = sample_name

qc_noFilter <- bc_seq_qc(fq_files)
bc_plot_seqQc(qc_noFilter)

fq_filter <- bc_seq_filter(
  fq_files,
  min_average_quality = 30,
  min_read_length = 60,
  sample_name = sample_name)

pattern <- "([ACGA]{12})CTCGAGGTCATCGAAGTATC([ACGT]+)CCGTAGCAAGCTCGAGAGTAGACCTACT"
bc_obj_umi <- bc_extract(
  fq_filter,
  sample_name = sample_name,
  pattern = pattern,
  maxLDist = 0,
  pattern_type = c(UMI = 1, barcode = 2))

bc_obj_umi_sub <- bc_obj_umi[, c("781_mixa", "781_mixb")]

bc_obj_umi_sub <- bc_cure_umi(
    bc_obj_umi_sub, depth = 1, 
    isUniqueUMI = TRUE, 
    doFish = TRUE)

bc_obj_umi_sub <- bc_cure_depth(bc_obj_umi_sub, depth = 3, isUpdate = TRUE)

bc_cure_cluster(bc_obj_umi_sub)

bc_plot_single(bc_obj_umi_sub)

bc_2df(bc_obj_umi_sub)

bc_2matrix(bc_obj_umi_sub)

workflows.name: scrnaseq_sam_lineage_barcoding
workflows.intent: Extract lineage barcodes, cell barcodes, and UMIs from 10X Genomics single-cell RNA-seq SAM files.
input: sam_file (path to a SAM file derived from CellRanger BAM output)
workflows.stages: 1. Extract lineage barcodes, cell barcodes, and UMIs using bc_extract_sc_sam
workflows.code:
sam_file <- system.file("extdata", "scRNASeq_10X.sam", package = "CellBarcode")

d = bc_extract_sc_sam(
   sam = sam_file,
   pattern = "AGATCAG(.*)TGTGGTA",
   cell_barcode_tag = "CR",
   umi_tag = "UR"
)
